# CodeQL third-party content

No upstream CodeQL queries, libraries, or runtime binaries are vendored in Developer Security Workspace v0.1.0-preview.

If upstream MIT-licensed content from github/codeql is added in a future release, this directory must include:

- upstream URL
- exact upstream revision or commit
- LICENSE
- NOTICE
- UPSTREAM.md
- documented update process

The separately licensed CodeQL CLI/engine must not be copied into this directory.
